intent: A Bedrock plugin that registers zstd-dictionary-based compress()/decompress() SQLite user-defined functions, using dictionaries loaded once at startup from a dedicated DB table, plus equivalent static helpers for non-SQL callers.

objects.name: BedrockPlugin_Compression
objects.role: loads dictionaries at startup, creates the zstdDictionaries table, registers the SQLite UDFs, and exposes compress()/decompress(); has no BedrockCommand of its own

objects.name: BedrockPlugin_Compression::ZDictionaries
objects.role: pairs one dictionary ID's compiled ZSTD_CDict* and ZSTD_DDict*

objects.name: BedrockPlugin_Compression::_dictionaries
objects.role: map of dictionary ID to ZDictionaries, populated once at startup

objects.name: BedrockPlugin_Compression::COMPRESSION_LEVEL
objects.role: zstd level used for all dictionary-based compression

objects.name: sqliteCompress
objects.role: the compress(data, dictionaryID) SQLite UDF callback
